component: Mac Dock menu ownership and preferences opening

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The dock menu and handler script move from an ordinary messenger document to hiddenWindowMac. The handler initializes a native menu and gives it to the dock service. Dock Options waits for the preferences callback before opening its subdialog; current code calls openPreferencesTab directly. The promise describes callback completion, with separate reuse/closure limits, and does not establish measured leak elimination.
title: The native Dock menu is owned by the hidden Mac document
